title: Cilla Skyn About Hero

fields.label: Background Image
fields.name: background_image
fields.instructions: Optional. Renders full-bleed behind the text with a soft cream wash over it to keep the copy readable. Leave empty for a plain cream panel.

fields.label: Background Overlay Color
fields.name: overlay_color
fields.instructions: Wash placed over the Background Image so the text stays readable. Click the swatch and drag the opacity slider at the bottom of the picker to adjust how strong the wash is — a fully transparent colour shows the photo untouched. Has no visible effect until a Background Image is set above.

fields.label: Text Color
fields.name: text_color
fields.instructions: Overrides the Heading, Intro, Description and Tagline colour — useful for light text over a dark Background Image. Doesn't affect the Eyebrow, which always stays the brand gold accent.

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.name: eyebrow
fields.instructions: Small uppercase label above the heading.

fields.label: Intro
fields.name: intro
fields.instructions: First, short brand-statement paragraph. Full rich-text editor: bold/italic, headings, lists, links. Use "Add Media" to insert images or files, or paste a YouTube/Vimeo link on its own line to embed a video.
fields.default_value: Cilla Skyn™ is a modern African skincare brand creating thoughtful, sensorial formulations inspired by nature and refined by science.

fields.label: Description
fields.name: description
fields.instructions: Second, supporting paragraph. Full rich-text editor: bold/italic, headings, lists, links. Use "Add Media" to insert images or files, or paste a YouTube/Vimeo link on its own line to embed a video.
fields.default_value: We believe skincare should do more than simply sit on the skin. It should feel considered, purposeful and beautifully balanced — from the ingredients chosen to the textures experienced and the rituals created around them.

fields.label: Tagline
fields.name: tagline
fields.instructions: Small uppercase closing line, flanked by rules.
fields.default_value: Thoughtfully formulated. Purposefully layered. Inspired by nature.

description: Centered brand-statement intro for the About page.
